description: The OpenProposal `LineItemSummary` profile: the fields of the `LineItem` document that the specification lists for it.

addressable_scale.description: Reachable units in the flight, recomputed against the buyer's selection. Not segment size

channel.description: `display` | `video` | `audio` | `ctv` | `dooh` | `native`. The discriminator for how the rest of the line item is read

committed_metrics.description: `{ metric, value, basis }` tuples — `viewable_rate` for display, `completion_rate` for video/audio/CTV, an audience-modelled metric for DOOH. Seller declares a ceiling; a buyer MAY request above it

min_spend.description: Minimum spend for this line item

pricing.description: The line item's `pricing[]`, each entry projected to `cost_method`, `gross_rate`, and `currency`.

transaction_mechanism.description: `available[]` from `DIRECT_IO` | `PROGRAMMATIC_GUARANTEED` | `PREFERRED_DEAL` | `PRIVATE_AUCTION` | `OPEN_AUCTION`. A seller MAY offer the same inventory through more than one

title: LineItemSummary
